events.title: Triangle Festa
events.venue: Soshigaya Park, Seijo-dori Park West Promenade, and Sophia University International Exchange Center
events.summary: Enjoy food stalls, game booths, vegetable sales, and mini steam train rides at this community festival.

events.title: Futakotamagawa Oyama-michi Festival
events.summary: Experience local community booths and activities themed around the historic Oyama-michi highway.

events.title: Japanese Red Cross Soshigaya Bazaar
events.summary: Find a variety of second-hand goods and daily necessities at this charity bazaar.

events.title: Seijo Community Cultural Festival
events.venue: Kinuta General Branch Office and Seijo Hall
events.summary: Generations come together for stage performances, food corners, and kids' activities.

events.title: Soshigaya Recycle Fair
events.summary: Browse a flea market, try repair services for toys and umbrellas, and join recycling quizzes.
